exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MUNDARIJA (Contents).

  Kitobning 3-beti. Mashq yo'q.


TO'LIQ MUNDARIJA:

  Unit 1   Hi!                        p. 4
  Unit 2   A Friend in Need...        p. 8
  Unit 3   Home Sweet Home            p. 12
  Unit 4   Like Father, like Son      p. 16
  Unit 5   An Early Bird or a
           Night Owl?                 p. 20
  Unit 6   Birds of a Feather...      p. 24
  Unit 7   Come Rain or Shine         p. 28
  Unit 8   Enjoy your Meal            p. 32
  Unit 9   Times Change...            p. 36
  Unit 10  The Price of Fame          p. 40
  Unit 11  All's Well that Ends Well  p. 44
  Unit 12  See New Places,
           Meet New Faces             p. 48
  Unit 13  Time will Tell             p. 52
  Unit 14  Dos and Don'ts             p. 56
  Unit 15  Take a Break               p. 60
           Progress Tests             p. 65
           Video Projects             p. 83


⚠ HAR UNIT ANIQ 4 BETDAN:

  4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40,
  44, 48, 52, 56, 60

  Har raqam oldingisidan 4 ga katta!

  Ya'ni har unitga ANIQ TO'RT bet
  ajratilgan — kitob juda tartibli
  tuzilgan.

  15 unit × 4 bet = 60 bet
  (4-betdan 63-betgacha)


⚠ UNIT NOMLARI — DEYARLI HAMMASI
INGLIZ MAQOLI YOKI IBORASI:

  2  'A Friend in Need...'
     To'liq maqol: 'A friend in need is a
     friend indeed.'
     = Do'st boshga kulfat tushganda
       bilinadi.
     ⚠ 1-nazorat testining 15-bandi aynan
     shu maqol edi!

  3  'Home Sweet Home'
     = Uy — eng shirin joy.

  4  'Like Father, like Son'
     = Otasiga o'xshaydi (qanday ota —
       shunday o'g'il).

  5  'An Early Bird or a Night Owl?'
     'an early bird' = erta turadigan odam
     'a night owl' = kechasi uxlamaydigan
        odam
     ⚠ 'The early bird catches the worm.'
       = Erta turgan yutadi.

  6  'Birds of a Feather...'
     To'liq maqol: 'Birds of a feather
     flock together.'
     = Bir xil qushlar birga uchadi
       (o'xshashlar bir yerga to'planadi).

  7  'Come Rain or Shine'
     = Yomg'irmi, quyoshmi — baribir
       (har qanday holatda).

  9  'Times Change...'
     = Zamonlar o'zgaradi.

 11  'All's Well that Ends Well'
     = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi
       yaxshi.
     ⚠ Bu — Shekspirning komediyasi nomi
     ham!

 12  'See New Places, Meet New Faces'
     = Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi
       yuzlarni uchrat.
     ⚠ QOFIYA: plACES — fACES.

 13  'Time will Tell'
     = Vaqt ko'rsatadi (kelajakda
       ma'lum bo'ladi).

 14  'Dos and Don'ts'
     = Mumkin va mumkin emas (qoidalar).
     ⚠ 'a do' = qilish kerak bo'lgan ish
       'a don't' = qilmaslik kerak

 15  'Take a Break'
     = Dam ol, tanaffus qil.


⚠ KITOBDAGI BOSMA XATO (14-unit):

  Kitobda: 'Dos and Don´ts'
  To'g'ri:  'Dos and Don'ts'

  Apostrof (') o'rniga URG'U BELGISI (´)
  ishlatilgan.

  ⚠ Bu — kompyuterda tez-tez uchraydigan
  xato: klaviaturadagi ikki belgi
  o'xshash ko'rinadi.


⚠ 'CONTENTS' — DOIM KO'PLIKDA:

  'contents' = mundarija

     'The CONTENTS ARE on page 3.'  ✓
     'The contents IS ...'          ✗

  ⚠ 'content' (birlikda) — boshqa ma'no:
  'mazmun' yoki 'mamnun'.


⚠ 'p.' QISQARTMASI:

  'p. 4' = page 4 (4-bet)
  'pp. 4-8' = pages 4-8 (4-8-betlar)

  ⚠ IKKI 'p' — KO'PLIK belgisi.


MUNDARIJANING OXIRGI IKKI QATORI:

  'Progress Tests   p. 65'
  'Video Projects   p. 83'

  ⚠ Bularda UNIT raqami YO'Q — chunki ular
  unit emas, qo'shimcha bo'limlar.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents    = mundarija (DOIM ko'plikda)
  a unit      = bo'lim
  p. (page)   = bet
  a proverb   = maqol
  an early bird = erta turadigan odam
  a night owl = kechasi uxlamaydigan odam
  a feather   = pat
  to flock    = to'planmoq
  fame        = shuhrat
  a break     = tanaffus, dam
